versions.changelog:
aisa-provider-slot3 v1.0.4

- Documentation and reference materials updated across SKILL.md, pricing, guide (zh-CN), and config-examples.
- No changes to setup procedures or configuration—information and guidance have been refreshed.
- No code or onboarding scripts added; the skill remains documentation/reference only.

Version 1.0.3 of aisa-provider-slot3 — Changelog:

- Updated SKILL.md with revised and clarified instructions for model availability and configuration.
- Streamlined guidance on Kimi K2.5: removed a dedicated, detailed section and replaced it with concise best-practice notes about availability and temperature support.
- Added and clarified versioned model ID mapping and error-handling instructions, including a troubleshooting table for common and correct IDs.
- Emphasized using the `/v1/models` endpoint to list all available models and verify model IDs.
- Simplified comparative tables and removed speculative claims; focused on actionable, up-to-date instructions.

aisa-provider-slot3 v1.0.2

- Simplified and clarified SKILL.md to focus on setup, trust boundaries, example config, and verifiable references.
- Tightened description and usage guidance; emphasized OpenAI compatibility and best practices for provider configuration.
- Removed marketing language, unverifiable privacy/partnership claims, and non-actionable vendor statements from documentation.
- Made current model IDs and setup instructions more prominent while encouraging users to verify any model availability and data terms directly.
- Added official homepage and source links to metadata.

- Initial release of the AIsa provider skill for OpenClaw (v1.0.1).
- Enables seamless configuration and production usage of major Chinese AI models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi K2.5, Doubao) via official partnerships.
- Supports multiple setup methods: environment variable, CLI onboarding, and manual JSON config.
- Includes detailed pricing and model comparison, highlighting savings and enterprise-grade privacy guarantees—especially for Kimi K2.5 under Zero Data Retention agreements.
- Lists pre-configured, API-verified models and outlines Kimi K2.5’s temperature requirement and usage guidelines.
